title: Best perfume gift sets UK 2026: for her, for him and under £30
body:
A perfume gift set is the easiest way to give someone a scent they already love, with something extra in the box: a travel spray, a matching body lotion or a few miniatures. This guide is our pick of the perfume gift sets in stock for Christmas 2026, sorted by who you are buying for and what you want to spend. Every set is 100% authentic and shipped from the UK.

How to choose a perfume gift set

  • You know their perfume: buy the set of that scent. A full bottle with a travel spray or lotion costs little more than the bottle alone.
  • You know the brand, not the scent: a miniature set lets them try several perfumes from the same house.
  • You know neither: choose a discovery set, then they can buy the full bottle of the one they like.

Perfume gift sets for her

Full-bottle sets, from the biggest box down:

  • Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Gift Set (£84.99): 100ml eau de parfum, a 10ml travel spray and a 100ml body lotion. A creamy white floral of jasmine and tuberose.
  • Chloé Nomade Gift Set (£66.99): a 75ml eau de parfum and a 20ml travel spray. Mirabelle plum, freesia and oakmoss, a floral chypre that suits the office as well as an evening out.
  • Dolce & Gabbana The One for Women Gift Set (£64.99): two 50ml bottles of a fruity amber floral with peach, lychee, jasmine and vanilla. One for home, one for her bag.
  • Elie Saab Le Parfum Lumière Gift Set (£48.99): 90ml eau de parfum, a 10ml spray and a 75ml body lotion, with orange blossom, jasmine and tuberose.
  • Gucci Guilty Pour Femme Gift Set (£47.99): 50ml eau de parfum with a 50ml body lotion. Lilac, rose and violet over patchouli.
  • Elie Saab Girl of Now Lovely Gift Set (£38.99): 50ml eau de parfum and a 75ml body lotion, a sweeter scent of red berries, rose, almond and vanilla.

Miniature sets, for trying a whole range: Chloé Women’s Miniature Set (4 x 5ml) (£45.99), Jimmy Choo Women’s Miniature Set (5 x 4.5ml) (£42.99), Marc Jacobs Daisy and Perfect Miniature Set (£39.99), Dolce & Gabbana Women’s Miniature Set (£39.99) with Devotion, Q, Blue Jasmine, The One and Light Blue, and DKNY Delicious Miniature Set (4 x 7ml) (£35.99). See them all in perfume gift sets for her.

Aftershave gift sets for him

  • Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum 100ml + 10ml (£144): bergamot and Sichuan pepper over vanilla and ambroxan. If you only know he likes a fresh, popular scent, this is the safe choice. Our Sauvage EDT vs EDP vs Parfum guide explains the versions.
  • Bvlgari Man Glacial Essence 100ml + 15ml (£69.99): juniper, ginger and geranium over clean woods. Crisp and easy to wear every day.
  • Bvlgari Man Terrae Essence 100ml + 15ml (£69.99): citron and calamansi over vetiver, orris and an earthy, resinous base.
  • Bvlgari Man Wood Essence 100ml + 15ml (£64.99): citrus, coriander, cypress and vetiver, a green woody scent.
  • Azzaro The Most Wanted Intense Gift Set (£68.99): a 100ml eau de toilette and two 10ml travel sprays, with bergamot, lavender and a moss liquor accord.
  • Dolce & Gabbana K Eau de Parfum 50ml + 5ml (£54.99): blood orange, lemon and juniper, then sage and lavender over cedarwood.

For a man who likes to switch, the Dolce & Gabbana Men’s Miniature Set (£34.99) holds Devotion, K in two versions, The One and Light Blue Pour Homme. More in aftershave gift sets for him.

Discovery sets for anyone

When you do not know their taste, a discovery set is the kindest gift. Dior Iconics Mini Set (5 x 5ml) (£92.99) has J’adore, Miss Dior, Hypnotic Poison and Sauvage. Hermès Miniature Set (4 x 7.5ml) (£64.99) holds four unisex scents from the Jardins collection. Chopard Gardens of Paradise (4 x 10ml) (£59.99) holds Orange Mauresque, Miel d’Arabie, Jasmin Moghol and Rose Seljuke, and Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo (3 x 12ml) (£44.99) three bright Mediterranean scents. Not sure what EDP or EDT means on the box? Read extrait vs eau de parfum.

Perfume gift sets under £30

  • Korloff Paris Discovery Set (3 x 10ml) (£19.99): three women’s scents, from fresh and fruity to soft and warm.
  • Trussardi Pure Jasmine Gift Set (£29.99): a 60ml eau de parfum plus 10ml and 7ml minis, jasmine with bergamot, pistachio and vanilla.
  • Trussardi Ruby Red Gift Set (£29.99): a 60ml eau de parfum with a 125ml body emulsion.
  • Single 10ml minis in a gift-ready size: Gucci Bloom Parfum (£19.99) for her, Calvin Klein Eternity Parfum (£18.99) or Calvin Klein Defy Parfum (£18.99) for him.

For more under a budget, see gifts under £50 and gifts under £25, or our Christmas gift guide for skincare and stocking fillers too.

Good to know

  • Every set is 100% authentic and shipped from the UK.
  • UK delivery is free on orders over £40, and orders over £70 get £5 off at checkout. Shopping around Black Friday? Our Black Friday edit gathers in-stock gift sets in one place.
  • We hold limited stock of each set, so buy early if you have one in mind.
summary: Our pick of perfume gift sets for Christmas 2026: full-bottle sets and miniature sets for her, aftershave gift sets for him, discovery sets for anyone, and gifts under £30.
